title: Security and Risk Analysis, Minor (College of Information Sciences and Technology)
notes: 21cr exact bulletin match (minimum 6cr at 400-level). Prescribed CYBER 221 + SRA 111 + SRA 211 (9cr). CYBER 221's real prereq is SRA 111 AND one of CMPSC 101/121/IST 140 -- picked IST 140 for the 'select one' 3cr slot specifically because it's also the alternative that clears CYBER 221's own second prereq group, avoiding a dependency on CMPSC. Second 'select one' 3cr slot filled with IST 220 (no prereq) over SRA 231, since IST 220 also unlocks the CYBER 400-level electives below. 'Select 6cr from CYBER 451/454/456, IST 432/452/453, SRA 421/468/471/480' filled with CYBER 451 + CYBER 456 (both need IST 220 or CYBER 221, both already satisfied).
